_about: The paintings behind the site's art. art/build.py downloads each from Wikimedia Commons (Special:FilePath at `width`) and treats it; src/art/library.mjs and the /credits/ page read the same facts. Licence: every painter died more than 70 years ago (the latest, Luce, in 1941); `licence` quotes the Commons tag. `scene` is the alt text of its crops; `object` is the museum's or catalogue's page for the work.
